excerpt: Contact Us Thank you for your interest in Cleveland-Cliffs. In addition to this general "Contact Us" form, there are options below to efficiently direct your questions to the correct parties. Want to submit a RFQ or sales inquiry? Use our Sales Contact Form . Want to ask a pension question? Employees should direct any questions or requests for pension information to the Pension Service Center at (855) 409-9588 Want to apply for a job or inquiry about your application? Visit our Careers site. Résumés or inquiries on job applications submitted through this form will not be answered. Want to ask a community relations or sustainability question? Submit it to a Cleveland-Cliffs Community Relations Representative through our Community Inquiry Form . Want to submit an invoice?
